_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
U tirhisa michezo ya Klondike Solitaire. Kuphikelela kwako ku hundzuluxa khadi yote eka misingi ya michezo.

Milawu ya michezo:
- Misingi ya michezo (F1-F4): Akha eka Ace ku ya eka King eka suti
- Mipani ya michezo (T1-T7): Akha eka ku ya xiluva, ku hambana ka mabala (mabala ya ntima eka mabala ya basa, mabala ya basa eka mabala ya ntima)
- Stoko: Hluta khadi ku ya eka mpani wa makhombo
- Mpani wa makhombo (W): Khadi ya le henhla i tirhisiwa ku tirhisiwa

Mipimo:
- 'draw' - Hluta khadi eka stoko ku ya eka mpani wa makhombo
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Hluta khadi eka mipani ya michezo
  Swivuriso: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count yi nga tirhisiwa 'all', leyi yi ta ringeta ku hluta khadi yote ya le vini.
- 'forfeit' - Fikisa michezo hi ku ya n'wina na ku pfala makhandlelo ya wena ya sweswi
- Mipani ya michezo: W (mpani wa makhombo), F1-F4 (misingi ya michezo), T1-T7 (mipani ya michezo)

U nga tirhisa michezo yin'wana eka nkarhi wun'we hi ku hambanisa na makhensa:
  Swivuriso: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Fikela Kings yi nga tirhisiwa eka mipani ya michezo ya xiluva.
Michezo yi tirhisiwa hi ku ya mpangwana - loko yi hluleka, michezo yi salaka yi hlulekile.
Tirhisa 'forfeit' loko u kholwa ku ya michezo yi kona ku hlula.

format_error.no_brackets: Fomete ya xiendlo leyi nga tirhiki. Xiendlo xi fanele ku va eka swiangi.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Fomete ya xiendlo leyi nga tirhiki. Ku kayivela ka kholomu yo pfala ']'
format_error.empty_command: Xileriso lexi nga hava nchumu. Tsala 'draw' kumbe 'move <source><destination> [count]'.
format_error.move_needs_args: Xileriso xa Move xi lava xihlovo na xikongomelo. Matirhiselo: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_positive: Nhlayo i fanela ku va chanya kumbe 'all'
format_error.count_invalid: Nhlayo ya khwilo i fele. Tekela nambari kumbe 'all'
format_error.unknown_command: Khomando ra ku tiva '{cmd}'. U na komanda 'draw', 'move <source> <destination> [count]', kana 'forfeit'

action_result.before_failure: Ku endla {n} xiendlo (s) ku nga si va na xiphiqo.

move_result.drew: Ku suka eka khadi ra nhundzu ku ya eka thyaka.
move_result.cannot_draw: A swi koteki ku humesa mali, a ka ha ri na nchumu.
move_result.invalid_pile: Vito ra xiphepherhele a ri tirhisiwi. Tirhisa W, F1-F4, kumbe T1-T7
move_result.foundation_one_card: U nga rhurhisa khadi yi moja ntsena eka misava
move_result.waste_to_foundation_ok: Khadi leri tekiweke eka thyaka ri yisiwa eka masungulo F{dst}
move_result.waste_to_foundation_bad: A swi koteki ku yisa khadi ra thyaka eka nhulu ya masungulo
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_ok: Ku huma kadi eka matabelu T{src} ku ya foundation F{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_bad: A swi koteki ku fambisa khadi ra tafula eka nhulu ya masungulo
move_result.foundation_to_foundation: A swi koti ku suka eka masungulo ya yindlu yin'wana u ya eka yin'wanyana.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_one_card: U nga rhurhisa khadi rin'we ntsena eka thyaka ri ya eka tafula ra mintlangu.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_ok: Khadi leri susiweke eka thyaka ri yisiwa eka tafula T{dst}
move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: A swi koteki ku veka khadi ra xikhale eka nhulu ya tafula rero.
move_result.no_face_up: A ku na makhadi lama nga ni xikandza lexi pfuriweke leswaku u ma fambisa.
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_ok: Ku humesiwa {count} kadi(s) eka matabelu T{src} ku ya T{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: A ku na ku humesiwa {count} kadi(s) eka T{src} ku ya T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: U nga rhurhisa khadi rin'we ntsena ku suka eka masungulo ya phepha ra le henhla ri ya eka ro sungula.
move_result.foundation_empty: Xitirhisiwa F{src} a xi na nchumu.
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_ok: Khadi yi rhurhisiwile kusuka eka misava ya F{src} yiya eka misava ya T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_bad: A swi koteki ku veka khadi ra masungulo eka tafula T{dst}
move_result.to_waste_or_stock: A swi nge fambisiwi ku ya lahliwa kumbe ku hlayisiwa.

outcome.forfeit: Ntlangu wu tshikiwile. Nhlayo yo hetelela: {score} makhadi eka masungulo ya ntlango lowu.
outcome.won: Mawaku, mi winile eka ntlangu wa Klondike Solitaire!
outcome.turn_limit: Muthuki u fele! U kota muthuki wa {max_turns} wa muthuki. Muthuki wa wena: {score} khadi kwenye mphakelo wa khadi.
